changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.comment:
Prefill for the «add a provider» form: the known gateways with the two facts a user cannot possibly guess — base_url and the media dialect (see docs/decisions/media-transport.md). The rows are seeded from resources/seed/llm-providers.yaml on every start.
Ownership is split, and this is the whole point of the table: the seed owns the content (an upsert by code overwrites name/base_url/purpose_priority/… so a stale model id is fixed by a deploy rather than by a data migration), the installation owns `enabled` — it is never written by the seed, so a recommendation switched off here stays off across upgrades. A row whose code is absent from the seed (an on-prem corporate gateway) is not touched at all: the bootstrap iterates the file, not the table.
The catalogue never participates in resolution at call time. It fills a form; the source of truth for a working provider stays the llm_providers row — hence no unique constraint or foreign key tying the two together.
